Toni Kukoč

Pronunciation: \TOE-knee COO-coach\

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2021 (Full List)

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Toni Kukoč?

Toni Kukoč is 57 years old.

Where was Toni Kukoč born?

Toni Kukoč was born in Split, Croatia.

When was Toni Kukoč born?

Toni Kukoč was born on September 18, 1968.

How tall is Toni Kukoč?

Toni Kukoč is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Toni Kukoč weigh when playing?

Toni Kukoč weighed 192 lbs (87 kg) when playing.

Is Toni Kukoč in the Hall of Fame?

Toni Kukoč was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2021 (Full List) .

When was Toni Kukoč drafted?

Toni Kukoč was drafted by Chicago Bulls, 2nd round (2nd pick, 29th overall), 1990 NBA Draft.

What position did Toni Kukoč play?

Small Forward and Power Forward.

When did Toni Kukoč retire?

Toni Kukoč last played in 2006.

What is Toni Kukoč's net worth?

Toni Kukoč made at least $61,488,033 playing professional basketball.

How much did Toni Kukoč make?

Toni Kukoč made $9,056,250 in 2004.

What did Toni Kukoč average?

Toni Kukoč averaged 11.6 points, 4.2 rebounds, and 3.7 assists per game.

How many rings does Toni Kukoč have?

Toni Kukoč won 3 championships.

What are Toni Kukoč's nicknames?

Croatian Sensation, The Waiter, Euro-Magic, The Pink Panther, Spider of Split, Kuki, Alien, Special K are nicknames for Toni Kukoč.
